<CODEX_HOME>.config.toml:
daemon_auto_start = false
check_for_update_on_startup = false

[mcp_servers.barry]
url = "http://127.0.0.1:4510/mcp?sessionId=golden"
bearer_token_env_var = "BARRY_CODEX_MCP_BARRY_BEARER_TOKEN"

[mcp_servers.local]
command = "node"
args = ["server.js"]

[mcp_servers.local.env]
